recommendations.headline: Call quality, not price, is the real conversion lever: satisfied-call customers close at 72% versus just 15% for neutral calls, yet 310 calls end with no fixed follow-up and 184 get no quote sent at all.
behaviour: Price enquiries dominate (677/1993 = 34% of intents) and price_shopper is the top tagged behaviour (349), with comparing_quotes at 213 and competitors like JSW (53), Tata (37) and Asian (22) actively named.
Most calls end in a callback (919, 46%) rather than an order (392, 20%), showing customers delay decisions and need a second touch.
Price is actually discussed in only 612 of 1993 calls (not_discussed 1381 = 69%), yet price_high is still the #1 objection (289) - the conversation is being avoided or deferred rather than resolved.
Top stated needs are fast_delivery (374), stock_availability (346) and technical_advice (325) - all ahead of pure price negotiation, showing service factors matter as much as rate.
Repeat_buyer (185) and bulk_buyer (181) are common behaviours but loyal_to_us is tagged on only 17 calls, suggesting repeat custom isn't being recognised or reinforced.
satisfaction: Only 34% of calls are rated satisfied (678/1993); 53% are neutral (1059) and 8% dissatisfied (168) - the bulk of calls leave no strong positive impression.
Satisfaction is the single strongest predictor of sales: win rate is 72% when satisfied vs 15% neutral and just 6% dissatisfied - a ~12x swing driven by call experience, not price.

When price is actually discussed, 211 customers accept it outright vs 323 still negotiating and only 64 call it too high - rate itself is rarely a hard blocker once engaged (price_blocker_pct is 17%).
Negative sentiment sits at 12.4% (248 calls) and complaints are 7% of intents (140) - a meaningful minority leaving calls unhappy, mirroring the 335 slow/unclear-answer misses logged.

conversion.title: Lock a fixed follow-up date on every callback
conversion.evidence: callback is the top outcome (919, 46%) and no_follow_up_fixed is the #2 rep miss (310 calls)
conversion.action: Reps must state and log an exact callback date/time before ending any non-order call; managers audit CRM for calls without one.

conversion.title: Send a quote same-call, every time
conversion.evidence: no_quote_sent flagged on 184 calls while price_enquiry is 34% of all intents
conversion.action: Make WhatsApp/email quote-send mandatory within the call or within 15 minutes; add a 'quote sent' checkbox to call logging.

conversion.title: Always ask for the order explicitly
conversion.evidence: didnt_ask_for_order found in 179 calls despite 284 customers tagged 'interested'
conversion.action: Train reps to end every qualified call with a direct order ask ('shall I book this for you?') rather than leaving it open.

conversion.title: Speed up and standardise technical/spec answers
conversion.evidence: slow_or_unclear_answer is the single biggest rep miss (335 calls) and needs_technical_help is the 2nd most common behaviour (291)
conversion.action: Equip every rep with a quick-reference sheet (thickness, gauge, color, size limits) so common spec questions are answered instantly on the call.

conversion.title: Offer alternatives instead of losing the call on stock-outs
conversion.evidence: stock_availability is the #2 objection (267 calls, win 25%) and didnt_offer_alternative appears 110 times
conversion.action: When an exact color/size is unavailable, reps must proactively suggest nearest in-stock alternative or confirmed ETA before ending the call.

conversion.title: Qualify segment and requirement upfront
conversion.evidence: 'unknown' segment has the lowest win rate (25% over 697 calls) and didnt_ask_requirement is logged 84 times
conversion.action: Add a mandatory first-30-second script to capture customer type (dealer/fabricator/contractor/end-user) and exact requirement.

conversion.title: Counter price/competitor objections with value, not discount
conversion.evidence: price_high (289 calls, win 28%) and competitor_cheaper (75 calls, win 23%) are top objections; didnt_highlight_value missed 66 times
conversion.action: Train reps on a standard value script (brand authorisation, consistent supply, delivery reliability) to use before any price concession is considered.

offers.title: Instant WhatsApp photo + quote service
offers.for_whom: All price_enquiry and product_info callers (677+390 calls)
offers.why: Customers repeatedly ask for photos and written quotes on calls that went well, and no_quote_sent is a top miss (184 calls)

offers.title: Promote cutting/customisation service clearly
offers.for_whom: Fabricators and customers needing non-standard lengths
offers.why: cutting_processing is a stated need in 88 calls and multiple questions ask about custom length/size cutting

offers.title: Dealer/bulk pricing and referral programme
offers.for_whom: Dealers (979 calls, 40% win) and bulk_buyers (181 tagged)
offers.why: Customers repeatedly ask 'what price do you give dealers' and 'will I get benefit for referring'; referral behaviour already seen in 22 calls

offers.title: Evaluate a short-term credit period for established buyers
offers.why: credit_period is a stated need in 60 calls, needs_credit behaviour in 66, and credit_terms objection appears 57 times with only 26% win rate

offers.title: Proactive stock-alert list for high-demand colours
offers.for_whom: Customers asking about Graphite Grey, Traffic Grey, Turquoise Blue etc.
offers.why: Multiple unresolved calls show customers turned away due to unavailable specific colours (stock_availability objection, 267 calls)

offers.title: Technical advisory/sampling support for new designs
offers.for_whom: Fabricators and project customers (bending, arch, panel-length queries)
offers.why: needs_technical_help (291) and technical_advice need (325) are among the highest-volume requirements

loyalty.title: Recognise repeat and bulk buyers formally
loyalty.how: Flag repeat_buyer/bulk_buyer accounts in CRM and have reps acknowledge order history on calls ('as always, same spec as last time')
loyalty.why: repeat_buyer (185) and bulk_buyer (181) are common, but loyal_to_us is tagged on only 17 calls - loyalty isn't being reinforced

loyalty.title: Non-monetary referral recognition
loyalty.how: Track and publicly/privately thank customers who refer new business (certificate, priority handling) instead of cash discount
loyalty.why: Referral behaviour appears in 22 calls and customers directly ask about referral benefits

loyalty.title: Single dedicated contact for top dealers
loyalty.how: Assign named account owner for dealer/contractor/builder segments so customers aren't passed between staff
loyalty.why: A customer explicitly complained about being 'passed between multiple staff over two days'; dealer segment is 49% of all calls (979)

loyalty.title: Priority delivery slots for consistent-supply customers
loyalty.how: Offer first-in-queue dispatch scheduling for customers with regular order patterns
loyalty.why: consistent_supply is a stated need in 105 calls and fast_delivery is the top need overall (374)

loyalty.title: Proactive quality documentation
loyalty.how: Automatically share test certificates/warranty info with repeat and high-value customers without being asked
loyalty.why: quality_doubt is an objection in 81 calls and test_certificate need appears in 15, both signalling a trust gap worth closing proactively

non_price_benefits.title: Fast, committed delivery timelines
non_price_benefits.why: fast_delivery is the single highest stated need (374 calls) and multiple questions ask 'when will I get it, maximum by when'

non_price_benefits.title: Wide brand and product range in one place
non_price_benefits.why: Top products span roofing sheet, Color On Plus, GI sheet, Pragathi, Radiance, purlin, screws and welding rods - a one-stop sourcing advantage

non_price_benefits.title: Cutting and customisation capability
non_price_benefits.why: cutting_processing need (88 calls) and frequent custom-length/size questions show this is a differentiator worth leading with

non_price_benefits.title: Consistent supply and quality assurance as authorised JSW distributor
non_price_benefits.why: consistent_supply (105) and quality_assurance (104) needs are common, and authorised-distributor status directly counters the quality_doubt objection (81 calls)

non_price_benefits.title: Responsive technical guidance on specs
non_price_benefits.why: needs_technical_help is the 2nd most common behaviour (291) - reps who answer confidently convert better given the 72% win rate on satisfied calls

non_price_benefits.title: Reliable after-sales and documentation support
non_price_benefits.why: after_sales_support need (35) and recurring requests for GST certificates, POs and signed confirmations show documentation speed builds trust

top_questions.question: Is [specific colour, e.g. Traffic Grey/Graphite Grey] available in stock?
top_questions.answer_tip: Check live stock on the call, and if unavailable, immediately offer the nearest alternative colour/thickness or a firm restock date.

top_questions.question: What is the rate per sheet/square meter for this thickness?
top_questions.answer_tip: Quote from the current rate card, state its validity period clearly upfront to avoid later disputes, and send written confirmation.

top_questions.question: Can you cut sheets to a custom length/size?
top_questions.answer_tip: Explain the cutting capability and any machine/length limits honestly; offer a sample test if the request is near the limit.

top_questions.question: What is the delivery time / can it be delivered today?
top_questions.answer_tip: Give a realistic committed window based on production/transport status and confirm with a follow-up call before the promised time.

top_questions.question: Can you provide credit terms?
top_questions.answer_tip: Explain that credit is assessed case-by-case based on order history and route the request to the manager rather than promising on the spot.

top_questions.question: Why did the price change after I submitted the PO?
top_questions.answer_tip: Proactively state price validity windows at the quotation stage so customers aren't surprised later; escalate disputes immediately rather than leaving them unresolved.

top_questions.question: What warranty/certification does the sheet carry?
top_questions.answer_tip: Have test certificates and warranty details ready to share immediately, especially for quality-sensitive or first-time buyers.

top_questions.question: What price do you give dealers, and is there a referral benefit?
top_questions.answer_tip: Clearly explain the dealer engagement approach and mention that referrals are recognised, directing serious volume queries to a manager.
